generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
GST is not paid separately for afforestation works.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Upload all Relevant Documents as per Schedule C
Within the final period of the tender, one must be committed to making an agreement excluding the work done according to the schedule.

technicalCriterionList.description: A work experience certificate must be attached, confirming the satisfactory completion of similar afforestation works over the past three years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). This certificate must be issued by an officer holding a rank not lower than that of a Deputy Conservator of Forests (DCF) from the respective Territorial or Wildlife Division.
